name: aso-skills
title_zh: 让 AI 助手接管 App Store 关键词与元数
tagline_zh: 独立开发者、增长团队：不用再手动扒榜单、猜关键词。让 Cursor 或 Claude Code 直接产出 ASO 。
tagline_en: Stop guessing keywords and scraping rankings. Let Cursor or Claude Code handle ASO metadata, competitor scans.
desc_en: AI agent skills for App Store Optimization (ASO) and app marketing. Built for indie developers, app marketers, and growth teams who want Cursor, Claude Code, or any Agent Skills-compatible AI assistant to help with keyword research, metadata optimization, competitor analysis, and app growth.
why_zh: 不是零散提示词，而是把 ASO 工作流拆成可复用技能块：关键词研究、元数据生成、竞品对比各自独立。
why_en: Not a prompt dump — modular skill blocks for keyword mining, metadata drafting, and competitor diffs. Compose them per task.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 App Store（含部分 Google Play 基础字段），不处理安卓商店的详细 A/B 测试或订阅定价策。
limit_en: App Store only (basic Google Play fields). No A/B test design or subscription pricing. Needs live internet for rankings; offline works only on text.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
